tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos skyong spyi'i tshogs 'khor gyi yi ge bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ma hā kā lā ya/ gang thugs chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /ma rungs 'dul phyir gtum drag skur bzhengs pa/ /rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral sogs/ /srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus btud nas/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig nyams pa'i dri sbyangs nas/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis dga' ston rgyas slad du/ /dam can rgya mtsho mnyes byed thabs kyi phul/ /tshogs 'khor bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'dir dbye 'o/ /de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor rjes rnams zhib pa gtor bsngo bskang chog rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin la/ dmigs bsal sbyor ba'i skabs su/ khyad par gyi dam rdzas pad+ma bhañji'i snod du/ ma dā na/ ba la gnyis nges par tshang dgos shing / gzhan yang bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag ci 'byor ba gtsang sbra dang ldan pa bkod pas mdzes pa yid 'khul nus pa bshams/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ kye rdo rje sogs bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor/ gtor bsngo/ bzlas bshags/ bskang bstod/ srid zhi ma bcas phyag len ltar grub rjes/ tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod chu chang gis bran/ byin rlabs rgyas pa kye rdor ltar byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan mang du brjod pas tshogs rdzas rnams zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon lnga'i sprin phung 'phro bas nam mkhas gar khyab thams cad khyab pa'i dmigs pa brtan po dang ldan pas tshogs phud cha bzhi ru bsgos pa'i dang po bla ma dkon mchog spyi la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /grub gnyis dga' ston rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥkā ro mu kham̐ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

lan gsum gyis phul/ cha gnyis pa yi dam la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /grub gnyis dga' ston rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /yi dam gyi gtor sngags lan gsum gyis phul/ cha gsum pa chos skyong la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /grub gnyis dga' ston rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /chos skyong rnams kyi gtor sngags lan gsum res phul/ cha bzhi pa gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /gru gnyis dga' ston rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /mkha' 'gro'i spyi'i gtor sngags lan gsum gyis phul/ cha bar pa rang gis rol pa ni/ rang nyid dpal ldan dges pa rdo rje yi/ /snying khar yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /lte bar gtum mo'i me yi klong dkyil du/ /'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas gsal ba la/ /tshogs mchod zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /lag gnyis dgang blugs gsal bas phul ba yis/ /zag med bde chen ye shes cher rgyas pas/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /grub gnyis dga' ston mchog tu rgyas par gyur/ /zhes brjod cing bsams la tshim par rol/ tshogs lhag chu chang gis bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/

phaiṃ/ zhes pas mgron bkug u ṣatsi ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi lhag ma 'dis/ /'byung po lhag ma la dbang mgron rigs kun/ /ngoms shing tshim pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing / /rtag tu phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces brjod la dpal 'bar bcas phyi rol du dor/ de nas rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis smon lam bcas grub nas gtor 'bul sogs dkyus ltar bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ grangs med gsum gyi dka' spyad mi dgos par/ /tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /tshe 'dir zung 'jug go 'phang la sbyor ba'i/ /gsang chen zab mo'i khyad chos 'di rmad byung / /de phyir thabs mang dka' ba med pa yi/ /bye brag tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga 'di/ /dam tshig nyams chags bskang dang mchog thun gyi/ /dngos grub myur du 'gugs byed thabs kyi phul/ /de phyir 'di la brtson pa'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /dam tshig rnam dag rim gnyis lam la brtson/ /spyod pas bogs dbyung nye rgyus mtshams sbyar nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar gnas shog /ces gur zhal gtso bo gyur pa'i chos skyong rnams kyi tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di ni sa bzang rnam rgyal gling gi mgon khang chen po dam can srung ma rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs pa'i gnas su kye rdor bsnyen song sngags pa bzhi sde re lo re la rtag bzhugs mdzad pa rnams kyis mgon po'i dus chen bzhi la tshogs 'khor re mdzad bzhed kyis cho ga nyung bsdus 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas rje rdo rje 'chang gi dus chen sa ga zla ba'i nyer lnga pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin dben gnas dam pa dga' ldan sa bzang du rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa snying por dril ba'i tshul gyis sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //
